from pathlib import Path
import sys
root = Path("30_Library/100_zettelkasten")
SOT = "SoT - Financial Philosophy and Spendfulness"
NOW = "2026-11-26T00:00:00+00:00"
EVID = f"Carried over from the earlier prose version of [[{SOT}]]; no outside source is cited."

def card(title, kind, fields, tags, opening, scope, implications, links, edges=(), evid=EVID):
    slug = title.lower().replace(" ", "-")
    fm = ["---", "conformant: true", f"created: {NOW}", f"modified: {NOW}",
          f"permalink: llmeon/30-library/100-zettelkasten/{slug}", "status: seed",
          f"tags: [{', '.join(tags)}]", f"title: {title}", f"type: {kind}", *fields, "---", ""]
    mark = "^def" if kind == "concept" else "^claim"
    body = [f"## {title}", "", f"{opening} {mark}", "", "### Scope & Conditions", "", scope, "",
            "### Evidence", "", evid, "", "### Implications", "",
            *[f"- {i}" for i in implications], "", "### Related", "",
            *[f"- [[{t}]]—{why}" for t, why in links]]
    for e in edges:
        body += ["", e]
    p = root / f"{title}.md"
    if p.exists():
        sys.exit(f"refusing to overwrite {p}")
    p.write_text("\n".join(fm + body) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
